title: Reference-native docs
note: A Mintlify and Scalar style page in Instrument Sans built as the docs portal itself: top tabs, search and a left nav, then a sample OpenAPI operation (POST /v1/refunds on acme-payments) with its parameters, request tabs for cURL, TypeScript, Python, Go, CLI and MCP, responses, and the release gate verdict per surface inline, followed by quickstart, eval report, gate checks with a receipt, spec repair diff, the live analyser endpoint with 25 September 2026 findings, pricing and a changelog.
